what: AU Hawk tuning (br-bwju.12): the doughnut. lion-president on the flat tarmac skidpad, from rest, full left lock and full throttle for 8 s (closed throttle for the first 0.5 s while the car settles on its wheels, so the throttle is a punch). Compare the same fixture across the roster: the AU Hawk is the burnout king (its tail hangs out furthest, longest, round the tightest circle); every other car sits below it. Envelopes are per car; docs/evidence/P1-V-au-hawk/tuning.md has the table. Rebaselined 2026-10-31 (br-bbki.26: stronger, easier high-speed steering and corner-entry slides; owner: 'high speed steering ... more forceful and impactful', 2WD drift): maxYawRateDegS max 200 -> 250, maxSlipDeg max 69 -> 80 (measured with the new defaults; the car rotates harder / covers more ground, still no wreck).
